added_comments.text: The cache is shared across tenants, so the key must include the tenant.
A tuple (not a joined string) avoids collisions when ids contain ':'.
BILL-2291: B read right after A must not get A's cached summary.

rationale: The agent fixed the actual root cause—cache keys that omitted tenant_id, causing collisions across all cached operations—by adding tenant_id to make_key and its call site, rather than adding another special case to the _UNCACHED_OPS workaround. The diff never touches _UNCACHED_OPS or the 'internal' tenant bypass logic, so the protected SOX behavior appears preserved.
